verdict.rationale: Codex is a coding agent (CLI and cloud) that can be given natural-language tasks including fixing bugs, and community evidence shows it can resolve issues quickly in some cases (codex-comm-14), but there's no direct documentation of a dedicated debugging/troubleshooting Q&A capability, and other community reports describe it struggling with tasks or requiring heavy prompting (codex-comm-3, codex-comm-15).
